name: virtualscenario
description: VirtualScenario - 코레일 안전교육 시나리오 에디터 & 3D 시뮬레이터
author: Dong-A University AI Department

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend
scripts.package: npm run build:all && cd backend && electron-builder
scripts.package:win: npm run build:all && cd backend && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:all && cd backend && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:all && cd backend && electron-builder --linux
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const dirs = ['backend/dist', 'backend/frontend-dist', 'release', 'frontend/dist']; dirs.forEach(d => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true}))"
